nodes.label: graphify export neo4j / neo4j-push
nodes.rationale: Uses MERGE semantics so pushing to a running Neo4j instance is safe to re-run without creating duplicates.

nodes.label: graphify MCP stdio server (--mcp)
nodes.rationale: Exposes query_graph/get_node/get_neighbors/get_community/god_nodes/graph_stats/shortest_path as MCP tools so other agents/orchestrators can query the graph live instead of re-parsing graph.json.

nodes.label: graphify token-reduction benchmark
nodes.rationale: Only runs when corpus total_words > 5000, because for small corpora the graph's value is structural clarity rather than measurable token compression.
